title: Refactor existing analysis pipeline to be tenant-scoped with DB cache backend
acceptance_criteria: New AnalysisService class orchestrates extraction → caching → OpenAI → store
Old lib/cache.ts deprecated — no code references remain
AnalysisService receives tenant context implicitly via TenantContext/RLS
Cache key includes tenant_id + resume_hash + section (no cross-tenant cache leaks)
OpenAI client remains stateless but analysis results stored per-tenant
Service writes to analyses table with tenant_id, resume_id, section, response_json
